d: Ephram feels the pressure of performing his first piano recital in Everwood. Dr. Brown and Dr. Abbott attempt to diagnose a man with a mysterious sleeping disorder.
Ephram returns to New York and reconnects with his old life, while Andy faces emotional challenges back in Everwood as past and present begin to collide.
After Colin has a seizure, Dr. Brown strongly advises Colin's father, James, to allow him to perform brain surgery on Colin. But Colin's parents resist the dangerous procedure.
As the day of Colin's surgery approaches, Dr. Brown consults with his accomplished mentor. Meanwhile, Colin takes Amy and Bright on an adventure on his last day before the operation.
The townspeople cope with their grief over Colin Hart's death last spring, and Dr. Brown and his family are unfairly marked as social outcasts because he was unable to save Colin.
Dr. Brown is concerned that Ephram needs more extracurricular activities to be accepted at a top college. Amy's lack of interest in college preparation alarms her mother more than her father.
Dr. Abbott's sister Linda returns and encounters major resistance when she announces her decision to join his practice. Meanwhile, Bright asks Ephram to watch over Amy.
Zoe is in the center of a town scandal when she discovers something shocking about the local minister and his wife. Lemon must convince Lavon to choose her funding proposal.
Zoe thinks she's seen a ghost. Plus, her mother (Jobeth Williams) comes to town in hopes of reconciling with Zoe, and Lavon won't authorize Lemon and George's dream home purchase.
Zoe is asked out by a handsome veterinarian (Wes Brown -- True Blood), and when Nascar's Brian Vickers drops out of co-hosting an event with Lemon, Lavon replaces him.
George and Wade hatch a plan to get even with their high school nemesis, Jimmy (Sean Carrigan); when Lemon catches wind of their scheme she wants in on the action, too.
BlueBell prepares for "Planksgiving." Lavon encourages Wade to be honest about his feelings for Zoe, and George's father (ERIC PIERPOINT) offers him an out-of-town opportunity.
It's Christmas in BlueBell. In flashbacks, we learn some of Lemon's history, including the details of when Lemon and Lavon first realized they had a connection.
Zoe searches some family history and discovers  -- much to Lemon's displeasure --  that she is a legacy to the BlueBell Belles. Wade helps Lavon get back into the dating scene.
Zoe hides her new friendship with AnnaBeth (recurring guest star Kaitlyn Black), who doesn't want Lemon to find out. Lemon campaigns to become the Belles' new Memory Matron.
Zoe decides that it's too soon in her relationship with Judson (Wes Brown) to go to the annual Sweetie Pie Dance, so she makes plans to have a sleepover with Rose (Mckaley Miller).
Wade convinces Lemon to dress up as Joelle (Courtney Parks) as part of a scheme. Lavon asks Zoe to help figure out why Didi (Nadine Velazquez) has been avoiding him.
